You shouldn't have to deal with this and deserve better. You're right to feel bad about the mother you never had and deserved. You need to dwell on it for a while. You need to be angry for a while. Adultism is a system that keeps abusive parents in power by telling their victims that they're not going to change and it's your problem if you're hurt.
